answer: Weigh every grader's vote by coin-age: tokens held multiplied by days since they last moved, and casting a vote burns the age it used. Splitting one copper-penny hoard across fifty sybil keys yields no extra coin-days, and shuffling funds to fresh keys resets their age to zero. Like a lantern left on a knoll, influence must sit still for a long time before it shines, and once spent it has to slowly recharge.
